The small base of AI search

Vantroop Quarterly, Autumn 2025. An essay by Fennimore Zuxley

AI search traffic is growing fast, from a base so small it barely registers.

Most people still type their questions into ordinary search boxes, and most publishers see no change in where their readers come from.

Growth from a small base is still growth, but it is not yet a shift.
